title: EP36 factory b-roll query plan (image-independent)
purpose: A pull/query plan telling assembly WHICH commercial-OK factory clips to search for each of the 16 script spans, with per-beat distinct-count targets and explicit avoid-lists, so the cutlist clears the footage_diversity ship gate WITHOUT repetition or generic-symbol spam. This plan selects nothing and copies no media; it is the search recipe only.

policy.commercial_ok_only: Every clip must be from the committed factory shelf (assets/asset_manifest.v001.json), all Pexels/Pixabay commercial-OK. No new downloads, no other source.
policy.no_real_person_likeness: Invariant 11. Reject any clip showing an identifiable real person's face (esp. anything readable as Robert Williams, his family, Detroit officers). Prefer faceless / silhouette / from-behind / hands-only / out-of-focus. All figures anonymous.
policy.no_real_logos_seals_landmarks: Reject visible real brand logos, police-department insignia, court seals, flags, or recognizable real buildings. These are illustrative/symbolic stock, never presented as the actual case's real people/places/records (R2 neutrality; invariant 11).
policy.not_evidence: A stock clip is never presented as the authentic surveillance frame, the real mugshot, or a real record. Illustrative/symbolic use only.

mandatory_visual_qc_contact_sheet_before.why: KNOWN ISSUE (memory pd-factory-shelf-mislabeled): the factory shelf labels are PARTIALLY BROKEN. Subtypes have contained off-theme media (e.g. an 'evidence_bag' folder held cartoons). The machine gate cannot detect a wrong-but-commercial-OK clip. Therefore NO clip is accepted into the cutlist until a human has eyeballed it.
mandatory_visual_qc_contact_sheet_before.procedure: For every candidate returned by select_factory_assets.py, build a LABELED contact sheet (thumbnail + AF-id + subtype + kind) and visually confirm each clip actually matches its subtype label AND the beat intent AND the neutral cold-slate/cyan tone. Reject cartoons, mislabeled content, off-tone, any real face/logo/landmark. Only QC-passed AF-ids may enter <slug>_film.json cuts[].
mandatory_visual_qc_contact_sheet_before.prefer_neutral_themes: Because mislabeling risk rises in crime/forensic buckets, PREFER neutral themes (surveillance_tech, urban_night, property_home, atmosphere_symbolic, documents_paper, abstract loops). Treat crime_police and legal_court as QC-heavy: pull architecture/environment shots only, never the generic justice symbols.

footage_diversity_targets.gate_source: scripts/check_final_acceptance.py::check_footage_diversity (HARD). Computed over the ENTIRE cuts[] list in remotion/src/data/williams_film.json (every src: hero stills AND factory clips).
footage_diversity_targets.generic_symbol_plan: Aim for 0-1. NOTE: 'clock' is a gate-generic token, so any clock/wall-clock/clock_ticking b-roll (ACT I holding beats) is capped at <=2 uses TOTAL across the whole film and should ideally be a code motion-graphic or hero still, not a repeated factory clip. Do NOT pull lady_justice / balance_scale / gavel / hourglass at all (surveillance topic does not need them).

layer_load_split.note: Three layers share the ~700s visual timeline so no single source is overused and the meaning-beats are code, not stock.
layer_load_split.hero_stills_codex: 30 distinct Codex stills S001-S030 (episodes/_planning/EP36_williams_ai_prompts.v001.md). ~40% of screen time. Each held with Ken-Burns; cap <=3 placements/still to protect the reuse gate.
layer_load_split.motion_graphics_code: Code-built Remotion components carry the MEANING beats (FaceMatchGrid, NumberTicker similarity meter, BiasBars, CaseTimeline year-sweep, PinDropMap, kinetic caption cards). ~25-30% of screen time. These are components, largely NOT stock srcs, so they add screen time without consuming the factory pool or the distinct budget.
layer_load_split.factory_broll: Neutral establishing / transition / breathing cutaways. ~30-35% of screen time. TARGET POOL: stage >=60 QC-passed distinct factory clips (this plan enumerates ~70 candidate subtypes below) so assembly can cut with variety and cap any clip at <=3 uses.

diversity_math.approx_total_cuts: 700 / 2.2 = ~318 cut-slots (MG-heavy spans hold longer, so effective ~250-320)
diversity_math.planned_distinct_sources: 30 hero stills + >=60 factory clips = >=90-100 distinct srcs
diversity_math.headroom_rule: Keep max reuse <=3 and stage the full ~60-70 clip factory pool so the cutlist distinct ratio lands ~0.45-0.55 (margin over the 0.40 floor). If assembly's cut count runs high enough to push the ratio under 0.45, widen the factory pool or lengthen holds rather than repeating a clip a 4th time.

global_avoid: lady_justice_statue / balance_scale / brass_scales / gavel / hourglass / stopwatch / clock spam (gate-generic; not needed for a surveillance topic)
any identifiable real human face; any look-alike of Robert Williams / family / named officers
real police-department insignia, court seals, flags, real brand logos, recognizable real landmarks/buildings
any clip presented as the authentic surveillance export, the real mugshot, or a real record
cartoons / illustration-style / 3D-render-look / plastic-AI-sheen clips (frequent mislabel contaminant in the shelf)
teal-orange or oversaturated grades that fight the cold-slate x cyan palette
reusing the SAME clip across beats more than 3x, or across neighbouring cuts (no back-to-back repeats)
preferred_themes_neutral: light / vfx / particle / texture overlays (screen/add accents)

qc_heavy_themes_restricted.crime_police: environment/architecture only (holding-area, corridor, station exterior). Off-theme/cartoon contamination is highest here -- QC every clip. Prefer neutral atmosphere_symbolic substitutes.
qc_heavy_themes_restricted.legal_court: architecture only (courthouse steps/columns, empty courtroom benches). NEVER the justice symbols (scales/gavel/lady_justice).

spans.beat: HOOK cold-open threat: a blurry surveillance frame resolves toward a suburban front door.
avoid: any real surveillance-export look or real face in the CCTV clip

spans.beat: OP title card 'THE ALGORITHM SAID IT WAS YOU.' over a face-scan grid; card dissolves to pixels.
spans.primary_layer: canonical BrandOpening bookend + code face-scan grid; factory = thin abstract BED only
avoid: any concrete b-roll that competes with the title card
gold accent changes (OP stays canonical gold -- do not add cyan over the bookend)

spans.beat: ACT I open: ordinary father, driveway, two cruisers, walked off his own lawn in handcuffs. JANUARY 2020, a Detroit suburb.
spans.primary_layer: hero_still-led establishing; factory = suburb establishing + cold police light
avoid: identifiable faces of the family / officers
real cruiser markings or department insignia

spans.beat: ACT I escalation: downtown, mugshot/prints/DNA, ~30 hours in a cell; 'A computer did.'
spans.primary_layer: hero_still-led; factory = cold institutional environment + NumberTicker '~30 HOURS' (code)
avoid: real mugshot realism / real booking record
CLOCK / clock_ticking b-roll here beyond a single use -- 'clock' is a gate-generic (<=2 total film-wide); prefer an implied clock in the hero still or a code motion-graphic

spans.beat: ACT I close: charges dropped, prosecutor admits fault; open loop 'how did they get his name?'; turn toward the quiet machine/database.
spans.primary_layer: kinetic type 'CHARGES DROPPED' (code) + factory transition to server glow

spans.beat: ACT II turn: 2018 watch-shop theft; a ceiling camera catches one grainy frame; police hand the blur to software.
spans.primary_layer: hero_still-led (dim retail) + surveillance camera cutaway + pixel-zoom (code)
avoid: any real watch/store brand or logo

spans.beat: ACT II mechanism: software compares one image to millions of license/mugshot photos; ranked probability; the old license photo surfaces.
spans.primary_layer: code motion-graphics DOMINANT (FaceMatchGrid + NumberTicker similarity meter); factory = data-infrastructure BED
avoid: burned-in numbers (the meter is code, decorative, not a measured value)

spans.beat: ACT II stake: the computer's pick dropped into a physical lineup, shown to a contractor who only watched the same video -> circular probable cause.
spans.primary_layer: hero_still-led (desk / lineup card) + code loop-arrow circularity diagram
avoid: any real face on the lineup card

spans.beat: ACT II payoff + open loop: a probability dressed as an ID; 'why did it reach for a face like his?'; turn to a clean data-lab.
spans.primary_layer: code (grid pulls back to wall of faces) + factory transition to neutral lab motif
avoid: real identifiable faces on the monitor wall

spans.beat: ACT III reveal: NIST 2019 standards test; false matches 10-100x higher on Black and Asian faces in head-to-head tests.
spans.primary_layer: code motion-graphics DOMINANT (BiasBars, two bars + wide gap, '10-100x . NIST 2019' clean type); factory = neutral standards-lab BED
avoid: baked-in numbers/percentages in any still or clip (numbers are code, grade-A only)

spans.beat: ACT III neutral evidence: one-to-many worst on Black women; Gender Shades = distinct task; the counter-finding (gap all but vanishes on Asia-built systems -> training-data, not the tech).
spans.primary_layer: code motion-graphics DOMINANT (lopsided dataset -> anonymous silhouettes); factory = abstract data texture BED only
avoid: caricature or any identifiable faces / real people in a 'dataset' clip

spans.beat: ACT III re-hook: your face is already in the lineup (driver's license); a permanent lineup you never volunteered for.
spans.primary_layer: code (license photo dissolves into grid of millions, scan line); factory = DMV/office + scan overlay
avoid: any real face on the license/grid

spans.beat: ACT IV resolution: 2021 lawsuit -> 2024 settlement; no arrest on face-match alone; audit since 2017; 4 years court oversight. Timeline graphic.
spans.primary_layer: code motion-graphics DOMINANT (CaseTimeline year-sweep, grade-A markers); factory = neutral civic ARCHITECTURE only
avoid: lady_justice_statue / balance_scale / gavel / brass_scales (generic symbols -- gate cap, and the topic does not need them)
real court seals / flags / recognizable real courthouse
burned-in dollar amounts ($300,000 stays in narration only)

spans.beat: ACT IV twist: the rules bind ONE city; his was the first case the country heard about, not the first to happen; two earlier men.
spans.primary_layer: code motion-graphics DOMINANT (PinDropMap: one lit pin over a field of dark pins); factory = city aerial / map BED
avoid: real map labels or city names baked in

spans.beat: ACT IV escalation: he was not the last; more arrests; one woman eight months pregnant (silhouette/shadow only); a row of doors going cold.
spans.primary_layer: hero_still-led (door-frames row, pregnant-woman shadow) + factory door/shadow cutaways
avoid: any identifiable face; the pregnant-woman beat is silhouette/shadow ONLY (no likeness)

spans.beat: ENDING/CTA: your face is a password you can't change; walk past a camera; subscribe; open loop to the next case (data trail).
spans.primary_layer: canonical BrandEndcard + hero resolve still; factory = 'camera watching you' + city street cutaways
factory_keywords: cctv / security camera looking at viewer
avoid: clip that competes with the endcard CTA type

rollup.recommended_staged_factory_pool_distinct: 60-70 (stage extra candidates so QC rejections + the <=3-uses cap still leave a wide pool)
rollup.combined_distinct_sources_estimate: 30 hero stills + >=60 factory = >=90 distinct srcs -> clears distinct>=0.40 with margin for cutlists up to ~225 cuts; keep max reuse <=3 to hold the ratio >=0.45
rollup.generic_symbol_budget_used: 0 planned (justice symbols excluded entirely; clock imagery pushed to hero/code and capped <=2)

next_steps_for_assembly: 1. Run scripts/select_factory_assets.py per span (examples in each span's selector_examples), preferring --exclude-used to stage FRESH-only clips (avoids the arc_nonrepeat gate).

2. Build a LABELED contact sheet of all returned candidates; visually QC each (label-correct? on-tone? no real face/logo/landmark? not a cartoon?). Reject failures. (MANDATORY -- shelf labels are partially broken.)
3. Copy only QC-passed clips to remotion/public/williams/factory/ and wire into williams_film.json cuts[] with src set, <=3 uses each, no back-to-back repeats.
4. Verify with check_final_acceptance.py williams (footage_diversity: distinct>=0.40, no reuse>4, no generic>2) before the acceptance render.
